title: Ansel and the Wolf
author: Gideon Yarrow
blurb: Xanthe Marchetti, a thief who steals memories, has never left the valley where magic cannot follow. But when the border wards fall on the same night the stars go out, she discovers that staying invisible was never really an option. To get through this, she must reforge a broken covenant between realms before the last dragon-fire gutters out.
style: wry first-person narration with emotional depth
